mentions.name: Velprium
mentions.description: A calendar workspace that treats calendar events as structured data rather than just blocks of time. It adds properties such as status, tags, ratings, and notes to events and uses them for diary and weekly review views. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/Postgres, and the Google Calendar API, with reliable two-way sync that avoids polluting the original Google Calendar data. The author is weighing whether the initial use case should be 'turn your calendar into a weekly review' or the broader idea of a time-based database.
mentions.problem: Planning in Google Calendar required manually reconstructing what actually happened in another tool during weekly reviews.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building Velprium: https://www.velprium.com

It's a calendar workspace that treats events as structured data rather than just blocks of time.

I built it because I was planning in Google Calendar, then manually reconstructing what actually happened in another tool during my weekly review.
